name: board
description: Moves a beads story through a 9-column pipeline (Grooming → Planning → Plan Review → Approval → Implementation → Verification → PR → Review → Done), one crew-rocket skill per job, with a live log and a per-story timeline. Configure projects via knowledge.beads_project_paths.
author: kirocrew
useCases: Run a beads story through grooming, planning, implementation, verification, PR, and review without leaving the dashboard.
See every story's current phase on one board, and its full job-run history (with live logs) in a timeline drawer.
